QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_2

question.text: Management fees accrue from WHICH date to WHICH date for a Category III AIF?

answer.text: From date of registration till fund tenure end
From date of First Close up to the date the AIF is dissolved
From date of subscription till year-end only
From in-principle approval till Final Close

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 6.1.1 specifies accrual from First Close until dissolution of the AIF. **The Trap:** Registration date pre-dates First Close; subscription date differs by investor. **Cross-Exam Context:** Aligns with AIF accounting standards used in CTR reporting. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Model the fee run-rate in the distributor's client presentation using First-Close-to-wind-up timeline.
